# Francisco Catarro

> Musician — guitarist, pianist, musical director, and producer. Born in Portugal, based in the UK, with over 10 years of live and studio experience.

Francisco Catarro is a versatile musician working across guitar, piano, and bass as a performer, musical director, and producer. This is his personal portfolio: live performance, session work, musical direction, and production.

## Skills & Roles

- Guitar, piano, bass
- Musical direction
- Music production, composition, arranging
- Live performance and session work
- Genres: rock, soul, jazz, classical, latin
